messages:
Maya: Quick idea — run a short microsurge to test activation timing vs credit size for webinar signups + promptpack onboarding. goal: move 2% -> 3.5% first-week activation for new cohorts. want to validate timing (instant credit on signup vs 24h nudges) and credit amount ($25 vs $75).
Liam: Love it. what channels? launch posts + webinar followups + in-app nudge?
Maya: Yep. channels = launch tweet/thread, 1x email to registrants, webinar thank-you flow, and in-product banner for new signups. also a small cohort routed to prompt templates instead of credits to test qualitative lift.
Nina: Routing note: we can use existing inbound rules to tag by signup source. suggest 60/40 split by region to keep promos balanced. can wire up cohort tag `activation_timing_test_v1`.
Owen: Metrics to track: first-week DAU (or usage events), percent who use credits, avg tokens consumed, median time-to-first-request, and retention at D7. also we should capture promptpack engagement separately.
Jess: For webinar copy, propose two CTAs: `Claim $25 Starter Credit — get going` and `Claim $75 Power Pack — build a prototype`. which is better for PLG?
Liam: Hypothesis: larger credit increases trial-to-power-user but might lower ARR efficiency. smaller credit quicker to scale. split test will tell. write two short social hooks:
Liam: Social A: "Ship AI features in hours — get $25 to bootstrap your first promptpack."
Liam: Social B: "Prototype a real feature with $75 in compute — limited seats."
Maya: Love both. add a timing axis: half cohort gets credit immediately on signup, half receives an in-app nudge 24h after signup plus email reminder.
Nina: Implementation checklist: create `activation_timing_test_v1` tag, deliver cohort assignments, wire marketing send windows (immediate vs 24h), update console banner variants (A/B). I can deploy the cohort logic tomorrow morning.
Owen: Please ensure event schema includes `promo_variant`, `credit_amount`, `promo_timing` for clean analytics. I can prepare a dashboard: conversion funnel, tokens consumed, median latency to first call.
Maya: Can someone draft the three onboarding nudge microcopies? short + 1 example prompt template for each credit size. quick draft here: 
Maya: Immediate credit nudge: "You're all set — $25 credit added. Start with this prompt: 

`Write a one-paragraph product explainer for our new feature called 'Smart Reply' aimed at PMs.`

24h nudge: "Heads up — here's $25 to try Redwood. Try this prompt to test quality: `Summarize support tickets about login failures into 3 bullets.`"

Large credit example: "$75 credit deposited. Build a quick prototype: `Create a landing page hero copy + 3 email subject lines for our new AI assistant.`"
Liam: These are nice. I'll refine microcopy and produce social assets. Who's owning the webinar follow-up email?
Jess: I can own webinar follow-up. plan: send immediate thank-you + CTA to claim credit; then 24h reminder for the delayed cohort. will create two email variants to match credit amounts.
Nina: Heads up: compliance thread — pulse-bot flagged that larger credits may need promo T&Cs text. @pulse-bot can you post the required snippet?
pulse-bot: Promo policy reminder: "Promotional credit offers are valid for 30 days from issuance. Credits not redeemable for cash. Abuse/fraud detection may result in hold or revocation."
Maya: Good call. add that to email footers and in-product CTA modal.
Owen: Timeline: cohort wiring + assets by Thu EOD, deploy on Fri morning, run for 10 days, analyze Mon following week. Is that OK?
Jess: Works for events calendar. I'll block design + copy time today and get assets by Wed.
Liam: I'll queue social scheduling and coordinate with growth for traffic spikes.
Nina: I'll run the routing job and ensure segment size is minimum 2k signups per arm for power in metric detection.
Maya: Nice. Last: success criteria — primary: lift to 3.5% first-week activation OR 30% higher token usage in the large-credit arm, whichever is clearer. Secondary: D7 retention lift and promptpack engagement.
Owen: I'll add those as flags on the dashboard and set a threshold alert.
Maya: Great — thanks team. putting a reminder here to sync post-run and capture qualitative feedback from promptpack users.
Jess: +1. excited to see which path wins :rocket:
